# Goblin Portal

> A native macOS terminal built for AI agents. Swift/AppKit. No Electron.

## Overview

Goblin Portal is a macOS terminal application designed for running AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and Agent AFK. Built entirely in Swift and AppKit, it delivers native macOS performance without Electron, V8, or a renderer process. The RAM that other terminals consume goes back to your agent.

Current version: v1.12.0 (October 10, 2026).

## Key Features

### Zero-Overhead Host
Swift and AppKit. No Electron, no V8, no renderer process. The RAM your terminal was quietly consuming goes back to your agent.

### Agent Workspaces
One Space per project root. Multiple agent sessions inside. Switch projects without losing context. Real macOS window tabs, not a reimplemented version of them.

### Sidebar File Tree
Browse files alongside the terminal with git status badges on every row. See what your agent changed without opening a second app.

### Measured Themes
Eight built-in palettes, each verified against contrast standards across 474 assertions. Catppuccin Mocha, Nord, Dracula, and more. All of them legible.

### GPU or CPU Rendering
Switch between Metal (GPU-accelerated) and Core Text rendering with one config line and a quick Cmd+R. High-throughput agent output scrolls without drama.

### Agent Status at a Glance
Green dot when a command succeeds, red when it fails. OSC 133 shell integration does the tracking. No polling, no tab switching, no guessing.

## Built-in Editor

### Syntax Highlighting
23 languages out of the box. Swift, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, Markdown, and more. Tree-sitter grammars with scope-aware token coloring.

### Command Palette and Symbols
Cmd+Shift+P fuzzy-filters every app command. Cmd+Shift+O jumps to symbols. Cmd+L goes to a line number. All keyboard-driven, no mouse required.

### Code Folding and Navigation
Indent-based fold and unfold with Cmd+Opt+[ and Cmd+Opt+]. Sticky scroll keeps the enclosing scope visible. Bracket pair highlighting.

### Multi-Cursor Editing
Cmd+D selects the next occurrence. Full multi-cursor support for parallel edits across a file. Same muscle memory as VS Code, without VS Code.

## Supported Agents

- **Agent AFK**: Autonomous agent runtime with daemon, Telegram, and REPL surfaces
- **Claude Code**: Anthropic's terminal-native coding agent. Runs entirely in your shell
- **Codex**: OpenAI's CLI agent for code generation and multi-file edits
- **Hermes**: Terminal agent framework with tool use and conversation memory

## Installation

### From source

1. Clone the repository:
   git clone https://github.com/griffinwork40/goblin-portal.git

2. Enter the app directory:
   cd goblin-portal/app

3. Bootstrap the vendored SwiftTerm dependency (clones and applies all 7 patches):
   ./Scripts/bootstrap-vendor.sh

4. Build a release bundle and launch:
   ./Scripts/make-app-bundle.sh release
   open build/GoblinPortal.app

If macOS Gatekeeper blocks the app:
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine build/GoblinPortal.app

### Pre-built DMG

Download: https://github.com/griffinwork40/goblin-portal/releases/download/v1.12.0/GoblinPortal-v1.12.0.dmg

## Keyboard Shortcuts

### Spaces and Documents
- Cmd+N: New Space (window tab)
- Cmd+T: New document in current Space
- Cmd+Shift+[ / Cmd+Shift+]: Previous / Next Space
- Cmd+Opt+Left / Cmd+Opt+Right: Previous / Next document
- Cmd+1 through Cmd+9: Jump to document by index

### View and Splits
- Cmd+B: Toggle sidebar
- Cmd+Shift+\: Split pane right
- Cmd+Shift+-: Split pane down
- Cmd+Shift+H/J/K/L: Focus pane left / down / up / right
- Ctrl+Cmd+F: Full screen
- Cmd+R: Reload config
- Cmd+,: Open Settings

### Font Size
- Cmd++: Zoom in (persists across tabs and relaunches)
- Cmd+-: Zoom out
- Cmd+0: Reset zoom to config font.size

### Line Editing
- Cmd+Delete: Delete to start of line
- Cmd+Fn+Delete: Delete to end of line
- Cmd+Left: Jump to start of line
- Cmd+Right: Jump to end of line
- Opt+Left: Jump back one word
- Opt+Right: Jump forward one word

## Themes

Eight built-in themes, all contrast-verified across 474 assertions:

1. Classic Repaired
2. Umber (default)
3. AFK Dark
4. AFK Light
5. Tokyo Night
6. Catppuccin Mocha
7. Nord
8. Dracula

## What's New in v1.12.0

Released October 10, 2026.

- **Sidebar follows tmux**: With tmux, the sidebar tracks the active pane directory through window and pane switches. Over ssh or mosh it stops following and shows a quiet note ("remote: host" or "following paused") instead of opening a remote path locally. A remote OSC 7 report is never treated as a local path.
- **Typing actions only work in a shell**: Insert Path, cd Here, Send Path (Cmd+Shift+C), and Run in Terminal (Cmd+Shift+R) check what is in front before sending. If vim, an agent, ssh, or a script is running, they refuse with a beep. Send Path and Run in Terminal also grey out in the menu.
- **No empty frame on cd**: The file tree lists folders off the main thread. The previous tree stays on screen until the new listing lands, so there is no empty frame when you change directory.
